title: A gate that names a host setup is checked on that host before the sprint starts
goal: /kb-sprint plan checks, before asking the start gate, that each answered gate naming a host setup (a Windows feature, an account type, a tool) holds on that host, and records the check. Failure it answers: SP-76inhw33's clean-host story was committed with the gate answer 'Windows Sandbox on a Windows 11 Pro machine', but the feature was off (a reboot to enable), and the story was dropped mid-sprint; the S4U task for the runner never started under an Entra ID account, found only by testing.
